offering_description.value: Manufactures plant-based beverages (oat, almond, soy, coconut) and fruit-based snacks and ingredients. Sells mainly to retailers, foodservice operators and food brands, largely as private label and co-manufactured products made in its own plants.

primary_products.value: plant-based milks; shelf-stable beverages and creamers; fruit snacks; frozen fruit; sunflower and other ingredients

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery retailers, foodservice and coffee chains, branded food companies

end_markets.value: grocery retail; foodservice; coffee shops; packaged food

revenue_model.value: product sales: private label and branded beverages, fruit snacks and ingredients sold to retailers and food companies; project or contract: co-manufacturing for customer brands under supply agreements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes oats, nuts, soy, fruit and other agricultural inputs into packaged foods for retailers and brands

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some exports

specialization.value: related lines: plant-based beverages, fruit-based snacks and ingredients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct to retailers, foodservice operators and food manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from FDA, USDA and Canadian CFIA, FSMA
